EmailTemplate.name: Nursing Majors
EmailTemplate.subject: Your options for pursuing a degree in nursing at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University! I highly encourage you to review ASU’s nursing website, as there are a few options for completing your BSN at ASU.
These options include:
Traditional Prelicensure Post-Baccalaureate BSN Online RN to BSN Concurrent Enrollment Programs.
Details about the course requirements for each can be reviewed online at https://nursingandhealth.asu.edu/degree-programs/undergraduate/nursing-bsn.
If you have additional questions about the requirements for these programs, please contact the nursing department directly at nursingandhealth@asu.edu or 602-496-0937.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
